thread:
Anya (Product): quick thread — rapid Qs from today's runtime roadmap
Anya (Product): @Liam @Jordan thanks for the talk. Two quick things we heard from PMs: 1) some teams saw tail latency spikes on long-context chat, 2) a few customers asked about deterministic fallbacks when a GPU pool is saturated.
Liam (VP Eng): thanks @Anya. short answers: 1) kernel v3.1 has a targeted fix for KV cache thrashing on >8k contexts, rolling canary next week. 2) we have a fallback policy in config: route to lower-spec quantized variant + async prewarm — will document.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): to add — tail spikes are mostly from mixed short/long request mixing. Temp mitigation: enable per-route batch size cap and prefix-aware batching. We're pushing a runtime flag `--batch-split-threshold` in the canary.
Sophia (Research): for the KV eviction: we're experimenting w/ an LRU+age hybrid that keeps recent prefixes pinned for x requests. Need more prod traces to tune x. @Jordan can we surface eviction stats in console?
Jordan (Eng Runtime): yes, plan: eviction metrics (evicted_keys, pinned_hits) in /metrics and a console chart. will include sample query.
Matthew (SRE): rollout note: canaries will run in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 only, 10% traffic. alert if p50 latency > baseline + 12ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 10m. ops-bot will create the alert.
ops-bot: created alert: runtime.kernel_canary.latency_threshold (id:alert-7742). link: https://console.internal/alerts/alert-7742
Anya (Product): great. follow-ups: a) will PMs get a short migration guide for changing per-route batch caps? b) can we get recommended defaults per workload (chat, embedding, rerank)?
Liam (VP Eng): a) yes, docs + migration snippets by EOW. b) recommended defaults: chat: batch cap 8, embedding: batch cap 256, rerank: batch cap 64. we'll tune for quantized models.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): quick config snippet:
```
route: /chat
batch_cap: 8
cache_policy: prefix-keep-3
fallback_model: model-qr-1
```
Anya (Product): perfect. last Q from infra: any timeline for kernel-level attention optimization (sparse attention) landing?
Sophia (Research): roadmap: prototype spike in Q3, canary in Q4 if perf delta holds. not guaranteed but prioritized for long-context workloads.
Matthew (SRE): ops note: if teams enable experimental kernels, mark them as opt-in and include rollback playbook. we'll schedule a tabletop run.
Liam (VP Eng): action items: 1) Jordan: add eviction metrics + config docs (due 3 business days). 2) Sophia: share spike objectives for sparse attention (due next Tues). 3) Docs team: migration guide + defaults (EOW). I'll follow up in this thread with links. :thumbsup:
Anya (Product): thanks everyone — feel free to drop quick clarifying Qs here rather than email.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): one tiny ask — teams seeing worst cases, drop sample traces (anonymized) to #eng-runtime-traces. helps tuning.
Anya (Product): noted. closing thread in 24h unless follow-ups.
